sections.title: Edge Cases Not Covered
sections.content:
**`buildReadinessTrend`**
- Empty logs → `No Data` state
- Single log → `Baseline` state
- `change = 1` (not ≥2) → `Stable`

**`buildSessionRecommendation`**
- Empty logs → `Start Logging`
- No ruck this week → `Base Ruck`
- No strength this week → `Strength Session`
- No run this week → `Steady Run`
- Improving trend, no fatigue → `Progressive Load`

**`buildWeekPlan`**
- Standard plan (stable readiness)
- Progressive plan (good trend + ≥3 sessions + no fatigue)

**`buildWeeklyLoadRisk`**
- High ruck frequency (≥3 ruck sessions)
- Dropping trend + ≥1 fatigue watch → high
- High session count (≥6) without recovery

**`getCompletionScore`**
- Partial scores (e.g. 3/7 fields complete)

**`calculateTrainingLogHealthScore`**
- Empty array → returns 0

**`reportBuilder`**
- Empty logs list
- Log fields containing newlines or `|` characters (sanitiseField path)
- `now` parameter overrides date correctly

---
